name: enchanter-hooks
description: vis-governed advisory Claude Code hooks: deterministic, fail-open enforcement of the conduct substrate at lifecycle events in-context conduct cannot self-time. v0.7 ships fifteen quiet, conditional hooks (speak only when they have something to say) across SessionStart / PreToolUse / PostToolUse / SubagentStart / Stop. v0.6 base: post-compaction checkpoint (F03), secret scan, config self-edit guard, substrate-engine-write guard (F24), append-only-ledger guard (F14), artifact-authorship guard, bash reversibility guard (F26), debug-artifact hygiene, syntax validation (F02/F14), stale-pathref guard (F02/F27), machine-path-leak guard. v0.7 adds context-taint-scan (F34 indirect prompt injection on retrieved tool_response), dependency-intent-receipt (supply-chain provenance), delegation-scope-guard (multi-agent laundering, SubagentStart), and evidence-gate (false completion, Stop) — plus an obligation-anchor extension to compact-checkpoint. Every hook exits 0 and never blocks.
